summary: Signed in at http://127.0.0.1:8098/ as admin (password accepted, redirected to the dashboard) and opened the Assets list (/hardware). The list reports "Showing 1 to 3 of 3 rows" (both unfiltered and when filtered by "Seed"), so the whole data set is three assets and every one of them has a name starting with "Seed:". Their names and asset tags as displayed in the grid: SEED-0001 / "Seed: Reception Laptop", SEED-0002 / "Seed: Training Laptop", SEED-0003 / "Seed: Spare Laptop" (all Bench Laptop Model, Bench Laptops, Ready to Deploy, Bench Warehouse).

text: In Snipe-IT, create a new Asset (hardware) with the name exactly 'fwsi21-n1 Bench Asset'. Set its model to 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose the option from the searchable dropdown, do not create a new model), status to 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), default location to 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown), and purchase date to 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields sensibly but do not create new models, locations, or users. Save the asset, then report the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned to it and confirm the model, status, location and purchase date shown on the asset's page.
